title: The Hidden Treasure
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Matthew 13:44: a man finds treasure hidden in a field, hides it again, and in his joy sells all he has to buy the field; the kingdom of heaven is worth more than everything, so commit your life to Christ.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parable of the mustard seed.
floor.question: How does God's kingdom begin in that parable?

representations: a field with treasure drawn underground
a scale: everything I have, the kingdom
steps: A man finds treasure in a field.
In joy he sells all he has.
contexts: a farmer who finds good soil
a young person giving time to church

board.do: Draw a field with a box underground.

board.say: What did the man do after he found it?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he sold all he had and bought the field.
Write "the kingdom of heaven is worth more than everything".

misconceptions.ask: What is the lesson of the hidden treasure (Matthew 13:44)?
misconceptions.repair: Begin with Jesus' words: "The kingdom of heaven is like". Ask what is worth more than everything.

listen_for: He kept what he had and took the treasure
misconceptions.ask: What did the man do after finding the treasure?
misconceptions.repair: Read 13:44: "in his joy he sold all he had". Ask why selling everything was a joy.
Read 13:44 and draw a field with the treasure underground.

listen_for: He dug it up and ran away with it
misconceptions.ask: How did the man get the treasure (Matthew 13:44)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 13:44: he bought the field. Jesus' point is how much it was worth to him.

checks.question: What is the lesson of the hidden treasure?
checks.answer: The kingdom of heaven is worth more than everything
